title: malus ioensis f. plena
intro: Malus ioensis f. plena, commonly known as the doubleflowering Shenandoah apple, is a cultivar of the Shenandoah apple tree (Malus ioensis). This plant is defined as a deciduous shrub or small tree, which is native to North America and is valued for its showy double flowers. The health benefits of Malus ioensis f. plena include its potential use in treating inflammation and promoting digestive health due to its high content of malic acid and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids.
